rows.value:

1x M.2 (M Key) :
 
Supports PCI-E 3.0 x4 (32Gb/s) & SATA III (6.0Gb/s) SSD (Ryzen series - Summit Ridge / Pinnacle Ridge / Raven Ridge); 
 
Supports SATA III (6.0Gb/s) SSD (A-series APU - Bristol Ridge)
* Specifications vary by CPU types

rows.value:
Realtek RTL 8111H
 
10/ 100/ 1000 Mb/s auto negotiation, Half / Full duplex capability

rows.label: USB
rows.value:
6x USB 3.1 Gen1 (5Gb/s) port (4 on rear I/Os and 2 via internal headers) 
 
6x USB 2.0 port (2 on rear I/Os and 4 via internal headers)

rows.value:
2x PCIe 2.0 x1 Slot
 
1x PCIe 3.0 x16 Slot (The bandwidth is depended on CPU)
